content.title: Flex LNG: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HAMILTON, Bermuda (AP) — Flex LNG Ltd. (FLNG) on Wednesday reported earnings of $17.7 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Hamilton, Bermuda-based company said it had net income of 33 cents. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs and to extinguish debt, came to 46 cents per share.
